meaning: 3D swept-cylinder residence reconstruction of actual integral-plume points/radii and mass*duration/hour. No new trajectory or cosmetic plume.
temporal_method: Interpolate concentration/optical-depth scalars before a single pigment mapping; never blend rendered RGB frames.
coupling: Fine pack covers all integral-plume trajectories for each reported interval; replace only coarse near_plume, never add it twice. Pending synchronization remains its original separate field.
scientific_limits: This cylinder geometry is a display reconstruction of the integral plume, not resolved building/nozzleCFD or native96cubed particle bins. Original F64 grid queries remain authoritative.
word_codec: Signed32 words; negative source escape preserves F32; cumulative deltas columns1..8 modulo2^32; byte planes[4,9,N]; gzip.
density_correction: Original encoded cylinder hourly mean mass divided by decoded cylinder volume; no native concentration data changed.
